parent_goal: Connect 0–60 interest to average acceleration without claiming the time is acceleration.
child_prompt: Car A goes from 0 to 60 in 4 seconds. Car B takes 8 seconds. Which car has greater average acceleration?
expected_signal: Child identifies Car A and explains that the same speed change took less time.
hint_1: Both cars make the same speed change: 0 to 60 miles per hour.
hint_2: The same change in less time means greater average acceleration.
reveal_text: It is Car A. Both cars go from 0 to 60, but Car A does it in less time.
